title: Fix clear_overdue_button_test.dart's push-spy test to verify SyncWriteFacade, the collaborator EditTrackScreen actually calls
rule: Feathers seam lens / TQ-8 (does the test exercise the real production code path?)
why: edit_track_screen.dart never imports or touches FirestoreGateway (grep confirms only sync_providers.dart is imported); its real _clearOverdue() calls SyncWriteFacade.pushProfileProgram(Map payload) — a single-arg interface that for non-tutored profiles is enqueued to the outbox (OutboxSyncWriteFacade.pushProfileProgram -> enqueueProfileProgram) and only reaches FirestoreGateway.pushProfileProgram(profileId:, data:) two layers later, asynchronously, via PushPipelineImpl. Test E instead hand-builds a parallel 'reanchorProgramTrack' helper (explicitly documented as 'mirrors the logic in edit_track_screen.dart's _clearOverdue() ... extracted here') that calls a mocked FirestoreGateway directly with named params. This is the ONLY test in the repo referencing _clearOverdue/clearOverdue (grep -rl over test/ returns just this file), so it is the sole regression coverage for the F-C1 fix (a documented past bug: the push to Firestore was missing). The helper's copy has already drifted from production — the real payload includes 'updated_at' (edit_track_screen.dart:394) but the test's reimplemented payload and its assertions omit that key entirely — proving the duplication is not being kept in sync. If _clearOverdue stops calling syncFacade?.pushProfileProgram, calls the wrong facade, or drops a payload field, this test suite stays green.
recommendation: Drive the real EditTrackScreen widget (pump + tap the Clear Overdue button + confirm dialog) with syncWriteFacadeProvider overridden to a mock/fake SyncWriteFacade, and assert on the Map payload SyncWriteFacade.pushProfileProgram receives (including updated_at) instead of hand-mocking FirestoreGateway from a reimplemented helper.
acceptance_criteria: Test fails (red) if edit_track_screen.dart's _clearOverdue() stops calling syncWriteFacadeProvider/pushProfileProgram
Test asserts the actual SyncWriteFacade.pushProfileProgram(Map) interface, not FirestoreGateway.pushProfileProgram(profileId:, data:)
Payload assertion includes every key the production code sends (profile_id, curriculum_id, program_id, tracking_start_date, tracking_start_ref, updated_at)
